title: Does Inoculation Transfer Across Tasks? Testing Cross-Task Generalization of the Prevention Mechanism

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If inoculation generalizes cross-task, it suggests a deeper safety mechanism. If not, it limits practical applicability. Clear implications for whether inoculation can be a general-purpose defense.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires designing a second harmful task (dangerous medical advice), creating a new dataset for it, and running a sequential two-phase finetuning pipeline. Beginners would find multi-phase finetuning and custom dataset creation challenging within the time budget.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two-phase finetuning with multiple conditions (inoculated phase 1 + harmful phase 2 with/without inoculation + baseline) creates at least 4 experimental conditions across 2 tasks. Scope is broad for 30 hours.
